functions.name: batch-create-isheet-items
functions.description: Submit up to 50 new iSheet records in one native multiple-record request and return its aggregate processing receipt.

date.description: Calendar date formatted internally for the column.

text.description: Ordinary text; empty means an intentional empty value.

value.description: Typed column value; fields must match the column type.

items.description: A column identifier and its typed value.

externalId.description: External reference for this record; not a deduplication guarantee.

notificationMode.description: Alerter policy applied to every submitted record when sheet alerts are enabled.

FunctionInput_highq_batchcreateisheetite.description: Submit one batch of new records to the same iSheet.

operationId.description: Progressive key for the whole submission, not an item ID.

providerStatus.description: Immediate provider processing status; does not establish individual outcomes.

FunctionOutput_highq_batchcreateisheetit.description: Aggregate processing receipt, without individual record outcomes.

tags.instructions: Use `create-isheet-item` for one record. All records must belong to the same sheet. Maximum 50 records per call. The receipt is not per-record success, and a retry can create duplicates or send more notifications.

functions.name: batch-delete-isheet-items
functions.description: Submit deletion of up to 50 selected records from one iSheet.

items.description: Selected record identifier; commas and ALL are forbidden.

itemIds.description: Selected record identifiers, maximum 50; ALL is forbidden.

FunctionInput_highq_batchdeleteisheetite.description: Selected records to delete from one iSheet.

operationId.description: Progressive key for the whole deletion submission.

providerStatus.description: Immediate provider state, without per-item success claims.

FunctionOutput_highq_batchdeleteisheetit.description: Aggregate receipt for the deletion submission, not individual deletion results.

tags.instructions: Use `delete-isheet-item` for one record. Maximum 50 IDs, all in one sheet. This is not whole-sheet deletion. Restore support is not established. The returned receipt covers the aggregate submission, not individual successes.

functions.name: create-folder
functions.description: Create a folder inside a known parent folder, with explicit permission-inheritance and duplicate-name choices.

folderId.description: Folder identifier in the external DMS.

parentFolderId.description: Parent-folder identifier in the external DMS.

description.description: Optional folder description; an empty string means no description.

inheritPermissions.description: Whether to inherit root-folder permissions at creation; defaults to the documented false choice.

FunctionInput_highq_createfolder.description: Folder metadata, parent, permission inheritance, and duplicate-name choices.

id.description: Identifier of the newly created HighQ folder.

link.description: Provider API resource link for the folder when returned.

FunctionOutput_highq_createfolder.description: The newly created HighQ folder identifier and optional resource link.

tags.instructions: Get a parent ID from `list-folders` or the site's root-folder details. Creating with inheritPermissions=false does not configure new access rules. Use `update-folder` to rename an existing folder. Duplicate names are allowed by default unless you choose otherwise.

functions.name: create-isheet-item
functions.description: Submit creation of one iSheet record using ordinary text and typed column values. Returns a processing receipt, not a completed record.

date.description: Calendar date; implementation applies the column's configured format.

text.description: Ordinary single- or multiline text, including an intentional empty string.

itemIds.description: Existing iSheet record identifiers for link or lookup columns.

type.description: Lookup namespace; task assignees allow only user or siteGroup.

choiceIds.description: Selected choice identifiers; empty selects no choices when allowed.

localTime.description: Column-local time, not a UTC instant; supported precision must match the column.

otherChoice.description: Free-text Other choice, only where enabled.

value.description: Typed value; use only fields appropriate to the column, not a provider payload.

items.description: One writable column and its typed value.

columns.description: Writable column values; omit a column to allow provider defaults.

externalId.description: Optional external-system reference, not an upsert or deduplication key.

notificationMode.description: Sheet alerter policy; effective only if enabled on the sheet.

FunctionInput_highq_createisheetitem.description: Create one iSheet record from ordinary text and typed column values.

operationId.description: HighQ progressive key for this submitted operation; not the new record ID.

providerStatus.description: HighQ processing status as returned, without claiming completion.

FunctionOutput_highq_createisheetitem.description: Immediate asynchronous processing receipt, not a completed record.

tags.instructions: Use for one new record; use `batch-create-isheet-items` for up to 50. Obtain column identifiers and configuration from the sheet. Notifications follow the selected mode. The returned operationId tracks asynchronous processing; do not retry an uncertain submission blindly.

functions.name: create-site
functions.description: Create a collaboration site, optionally from a site template, with selected modules and business references. Requires site-creation authority.

modules.description: Modules enabled at creation; required with a template.

description.description: Site description; empty is an intentional blank.

url.description: Provider-returned API resource link, not assumed to be a browser URL.

FunctionOutput_highq_createsite.description: Identity returned by HighQ for the created site.

tags.instructions: Use `list-sites` to find existing sites and preparation-state template sites. A template ID, landing page and module selection are needed when creating from a template. Creation can provision substantial content; verify an uncertain result before retrying.

functions.name: create-task
functions.description: Create a task in an existing task list, with optional assignments, dates, reminders, tags, and existing file attachments.

title.description: Task title as ordinary Unicode text.

statusId.description: Existing task status identifier valid for the destination site.

description.description: Task description content; omitted leaves the provider default, and an empty string creates an empty description.

startDate.description: Optional task start calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD; not a timestamp.

dueDate.description: Optional task due calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD; not a timestamp.

parentTaskId.description: Existing parent task identifier when creating a subtask; omitted creates a top-level task.

assignees.description: Users or groups to assign; omitted uses provider defaults and an empty array requests no assignees.

id.description: Identifier of the assigned user or site group.

type.description: Whether the identifier refers to a user or a group.

items.description: A user or site group to assign to the task.

tags.description: Tag names as ordinary text; omitted uses provider defaults.

items.description: A tag name as ordinary text.

reminders.description: Reminder rules relative to a task date; the corresponding startDate or dueDate must be supplied.

relativeTo.description: Task date before which to remind.

daysBefore.description: Whole calendar days before the selected task date.

items.description: A reminder relative to a supplied task calendar date.

attachmentFileIds.description: Identifiers of files already uploaded to the task attachments folder; no bytes are uploaded by this tool.

items.description: Identifier of an existing file in the task attachments folder.

FunctionInput_highq_createtask.description: Create a task in an existing HighQ task list using business values and calendar dates.

id.description: Identifier of the newly created task, usable with get-task.

FunctionOutput_highq_createtask.description: The identity of the newly created HighQ task; this does not establish reminder delivery.

instanceName.description: Instance context segment from the HighQ URL, between the hostname and /api.

taskApiVersion.description: Administrator-verified supported task API version; defaults to 4. Subtasks require at least 12.

taskDateFormat.description: Exact date format configured in the HighQ UI. Required when creating a task with dates.

taskDateLocale.description: HighQ UI BCP 47 locale for abbreviated month names; defaults to en-GB.

tags.instructions: Use `list-task-lists` to obtain the destination taskListId and `list-users` to identify user assignees. Obtain the site's task status ID from HighQ configuration or an existing task returned by `list-tasks`; custom status IDs are site-specific. Files must already be uploaded to the task attachments folder. Use `update-task` for an existing task. Creation is not safe to replay blindly after an uncertain result.

functions.name: create-user
functions.description: Create a system user with an existing organisation reference and optional profile details. Requires user-administration authority; it does not promise an invitation email or site membership.

bio.description: Biography content as ordinary text or intended markup, subject to HighQ validation.

email.description: New user's email address; must be acceptable to the organisation's domain policy.

links.description: Initial social, messaging and custom profile links; omitted uses provider defaults.

name.description: Provider link service name or custom label.

value.description: URL or account handle appropriate to the link category and name.

items.description: An initial profile link with its category, service name and value.

phone.description: Office phone in a format accepted by HighQ; ordinary display formatting is retained.

title.description: Name title or honorific; omitted leaves provider default.

mobile.description: Mobile phone in a format accepted by HighQ.

status.description: Initial lifecycle status; omitted uses HighQ's default, not an assumed active status.

addressId.description: Existing address reference; this tool does not create or edit address text.

department.description: Department value accepted by the organisation's metadata configuration.

externalId.description: External-system matching identifier; must satisfy HighQ uniqueness rules.

sourceType.description: User source classification; omitted uses provider default.

dateOfBirth.description: Birth calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD; no timezone or time of day.

languageCode.description: HighQ language code, for example en_GB.

specialities.description: Provider speciality text; no new delimiter semantics are imposed.

secretaryName.description: Secretary display name; HighQ may require a corresponding email.

organisationId.description: Existing organisation identifier to associate with the user.

secretaryEmail.description: Secretary email; for an unknown email HighQ may require secretaryName.

FunctionInput_highq_createuser.description: A new HighQ system user associated with an existing organisation, with optional profile details.

id.description: Identifier of the newly created system user.

FunctionOutput_highq_createuser.description: The identity of the newly created HighQ system user.

tags.instructions: Use `list-users` first to check for an existing email or external ID; creation is not an upsert. Obtain organisationId from HighQ's organisation administration. Use `update-user` for an existing user. This creates a system account/profile, not site membership, and does not guarantee an invitation is sent. Do not retry an uncertain create without checking `get-user` by email.

functions.name: delete-all-isheet-items

tags.instructions: Use only when every record in the sheet is intended for deletion. Use `delete-isheet-item` or `batch-delete-isheet-items` for a selection. Recovery is not established. The result is a processing receipt, not proof that deletion has finished.

functions.name: delete-isheet-item

functions.name: delete-task
functions.description: Delete an existing task. HighQ's documentation does not establish whether deletion is recoverable, so no restore guarantee is made.

FunctionOutput_highq_deletetask.description: The identity of the task HighQ acknowledged deleting.

tags.instructions: Obtain taskId from `list-tasks` and inspect `get-task` if needed. Use `update-task` to mark completion instead of deleting. This removes the task rather than its list. Recoverability and subtask cascade behavior are not established; do not assume a recycle bin exists.

functions.name: download-isheet-attachment

actorId.description: HighQ identifier of the user who caused the change, when supplied.

Content administrators can see item changes; ordinary users may receive only a position. Limit is 1–500, default 500.
